scope: Join started purge manifest/recovery operations and preserve the first relevant failure through post-purge and final notification/activity cleanup.
limitations: Exact source patch only; no installed Vortex or upstream cache is changed.
First observed rejection is preserved; synchronous startup failure stops further starts and joins earlier operations.
Joining this batch does not prove native descendants, extension listeners, unrelated filesystem work or host-global quiescence.
Non-cancellation purge failures remain primary if recovery also fails; a recovery failure replaces an otherwise swallowed ProcessCanceled.
The primary operation or recovery failure survives postPurge and final cleanup; filterManifest internal read tails remain unchanged.
